import MumfordLib.SingularCochains

/-!
# Affine singular simplices

Vertex lists in a standard simplex determine continuous affine simplices.
Their faces delete the corresponding vertices, so their integral singular
boundaries have the usual alternating vertex-deletion formula. These are the
geometric simplices needed for barycentric subdivision.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory Opposite
open scoped Simplicial

namespace Mumford.Analytic

variable {I J K : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype K]

/-- The affine parametrization with the prescribed vertices. -/
def affineSimplexMap (v : I → stdSimplex ℝ J) :
    C(stdSimplex ℝ I, stdSimplex ℝ J) where
  toFun t := ⟨∑ i, t i • (v i).val,
    (convex_stdSimplex ℝ J).sum_mem (fun i _ ↦ stdSimplex.zero_le t i)
      (stdSimplex.sum_eq_one t) (fun i _ ↦ (v i).property)⟩
  continuous_toFun := by
    apply Continuous.subtype_mk
    exact continuous_finsetSum _ (fun i _ ↦
      ((continuous_apply i).comp continuous_subtype_val).smul continuous_const)

@[simp]
theorem affineSimplexMap_apply (v : I → stdSimplex ℝ J)
    (t : stdSimplex ℝ I) (j : J) :
    affineSimplexMap v t j = ∑ i, t i * v i j := by
  change (∑ i, t i • (v i).val) j = _
  simp only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem affineSimplexMap_vertex [DecidableEq I]
    (v : I → stdSimplex ℝ J) (i : I) :
    affineSimplexMap v (stdSimplex.vertex i) = v i := by
  ext j
  simp [affineSimplexMap_apply, Pi.single_apply]

/-- Reindexing barycentric coordinates reindexes the vertex list. -/
theorem affineSimplexMap_map (v : J → stdSimplex ℝ K) (f : I → J)
    (t : stdSimplex ℝ I) :
    affineSimplexMap v (stdSimplex.map f t) = affineSimplexMap (v ∘ f) t := by
  classical
  ext k
  simp only [affineSimplexMap_apply, Function.comp_apply]
  change (∑ j, (FunOnFinite.linearMap ℝ ℝ f t) j * v j k) = _
  rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ f (fun i ↦ t i * v (f i) k)]
  simp only [FunOnFinite.linearMap_apply_apply]
  simp_rw [Finset.sum_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hi
  rw [hi]

variable {m n : ℕ}

/-- A vertex list defines a simplex in Mathlib's singular simplicial set. -/
def affineSingularSimplex (v : Fin (n + 1) → stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1))) :
    (TopCat.toSSet.obj (TopCat.of (stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1))))).obj (op ⦋n⦌) :=
  ((TopCat.of (stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1)))).toSSetObjEquiv (op ⦋n⦌)).symm
    (affineSimplexMap v)

/-- Faces of an affine singular simplex delete the corresponding vertex. -/
@[simp]
theorem affineSingularSimplex_face
    (v : Fin (n + 2) → stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1))) (i : Fin (n + 2)) :
    (TopCat.toSSet.obj (TopCat.of (stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1))))).δ i
        (affineSingularSimplex v) = affineSingularSimplex (v ∘ i.succAbove) := by
  apply ((TopCat.of (stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1)))).toSSetObjEquiv (op ⦋n⦌)).injective
  ext t : 1
  change affineSimplexMap v (stdSimplex.map i.succAbove t) =
    affineSimplexMap (v ∘ i.succAbove) t
  exact affineSimplexMap_map v i.succAbove t

/-- Affine simplices have the alternating vertex-deletion singular boundary. -/
@[reassoc]
theorem affineSingularSimplex_boundary
    (v : Fin (n + 2) → stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1))) :
    singularSimplexChain (affineSingularSimplex v) ≫
        (IntegralSingularChainComplex
          (TopCat.of (stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1))))).d (n + 1) n =
      ∑ i : Fin (n + 2), (-1 : ℤ) ^ i.val •
        singularSimplexChain (affineSingularSimplex (v ∘ i.succAbove)) := by
  simp only [singularSimplexChain_boundary, affineSingularSimplex_face]

/-- The face opposite the cone vertex is the original affine simplex. -/
@[simp]
theorem affineSingularSimplex_cone_face_zero
    (b : stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1)))
    (v : Fin (n + 1) → stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1))) :
    (TopCat.toSSet.obj (TopCat.of (stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1))))).δ 0
        (affineSingularSimplex (Fin.cons b v)) = affineSingularSimplex v := by
  rw [affineSingularSimplex_face]
  congr 1

/-- Every other face of an affine cone is the cone on the corresponding face. -/
@[simp]
theorem affineSingularSimplex_cone_face_succ
    (b : stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1)))
    (v : Fin (n + 2) → stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1))) (i : Fin (n + 2)) :
    (TopCat.toSSet.obj (TopCat.of (stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1))))).δ i.succ
        (affineSingularSimplex (Fin.cons b v)) =
      affineSingularSimplex (Fin.cons b (v ∘ i.succAbove)) := by
  rw [affineSingularSimplex_face]
  congr 1
  funext j
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j ↦ ?_) j <;> simp [Fin.succ_succAbove_succ]

/-- The affine cone identity `boundary(cone v) = v - cone(boundary v)`
in positive base degree, inside the actual integral singular chain complex. -/
@[reassoc]
theorem affineSingularSimplex_cone_boundary
    (b : stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1)))
    (v : Fin (n + 2) → stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1))) :
    singularSimplexChain (affineSingularSimplex (Fin.cons b v)) ≫
        (IntegralSingularChainComplex
          (TopCat.of (stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1))))).d (n + 2) (n + 1) =
      singularSimplexChain (affineSingularSimplex v) -
        ∑ i : Fin (n + 2), (-1 : ℤ) ^ i.val •
          singularSimplexChain (affineSingularSimplex (Fin.cons b (v ∘ i.succAbove))) := by
  rw [singularSimplexChain_boundary, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  simp only [affineSingularSimplex_cone_face_zero, affineSingularSimplex_cone_face_succ,
    Fin.val_zero, pow_zero, one_smul, Fin.val_succ, pow_succ, mul_neg_one,
    neg_smul, Finset.sum_neg_distrib, sub_eq_add_neg]

end Mumford.Analytic
